cards.title: E1 · India R1 negative filter (weakest cohorts)
cards.hypothesis: R1 top-3 with ma20_dist outside +1..+5 (n=82, 14.5% WR) AND R1 confidence 70-85 anti-signal (n=103, 13.16% WR) are the two weakest R1 cohorts. Filtering them should raise R1 5D WR toward R2 baseline 32.16%.
cards.acceptance: Filtered R1 5D WR >= production R1 + 5pp on n>=100

cards.title: E2 · India R2 rank_4_7 + RSI STRONG positive-boost
cards.hypothesis: Conditional 3-way `R2 · rank_4_7 · rsi=STRONG` shows 5D WR 72.73% (n=22, +46.96pp edge, sig+). Boost-tag matching R2 predictions forward · N>=100 promotion decision.
cards.acceptance: Boost cohort 5D WR >= 55% on n>=100 AND avg > 0.5%

cards.title: E3 · Stop-loss cross-market · India TIME_STOP_5D + USA TRAILING_10
cards.hypothesis: INDIA · TIME_STOP_5D expectancy +0.273% + 0.00% catastrophic on n=500. USA · TRAILING_10 expectancy +0.921% PF 1.309 on n=625. Advisory-only shadow confirms both prospectively.
cards.acceptance: INDIA: advisory median return >= CURRENT median + 0.3% AND cat-loss <= CURRENT on n>=100. USA: advisory net of TRAILING_10 >= CURRENT + 0.5% expectancy on n>=100.

cards.hypothesis: India investability_band ordering QUALITY > MARGINAL > AVOID > OK instead of expected QUALITY > OK > MARGINAL > AVOID. OK band (n=119) has 17.4% 5D WR · below AVOID (n=108) 19.2% · suggesting OK's internal calibration is broken.
cards.acceptance: Shadow band ordering becomes strictly monotonic in 5D WR with n>=100 per band across the observation window. Regularized cross-validation split must survive at least one holdout.

cards.hypothesis: In India, higher confidence_pct at prediction time predicts LOWER 5D forward win rate. Bucket audit shows WR spread of 23.88pp with monotonicity MIXED_DOWN.
cards.acceptance: Shadow 5D WR >= production 5D WR + 5pp AND shadow avg > production avg + 0.3% on n>=100 forward India predictions.

cards.hypothesis: Over 18 days, NSE universe (n=2747) 5D WR=32.25% avg=-0.388%. AEGIS-India (n=392) 5D WR=25.77% avg=-0.729%. Alpha = WR-6.48pp · avg-0.341%. AEGIS-India currently DESTROYS value relative to random pick.
cards.acceptance: Compound-shadow 5D WR >= universe-WR + 3pp AND compound-shadow avg > universe avg on n>=100 forward India predictions.

cards.hypothesis: Under 30-day historical replay, TIME_STOP_5D exit produces avg expectancy of -0.613% vs CURRENT -0.886%. TIME_STOP_5D also eliminates all catastrophic >10% losses (0.00% vs 0.20%).
cards.acceptance: Median advisory return over next 5D >= median current-policy return + 0.3% AND catastrophic-loss rate <= current on n>=100 advisory events.

cards.hypothesis: India R1 places QUALITY(57%) + OK(40%) high-confidence stocks in top-3 slots · these have 14.5% 5D WR. Meanwhile R2 rank_4_7 (n=56, 47% WR, +0.53% avg) is the only positive cohort. The ranker's top-3 selection is anti-correlated with outcome.
cards.acceptance: Shadow top-3 5D WR >= production top-3 5D WR + 10pp AND does NOT reduce rank_4_7 quality by more than 2pp on n>=50 top-3 candidates.

cards.title: India R1/R2 Ranking · confidence + top-3 slot filter
cards.hypothesis: Two mechanisms compound to produce India's negative alpha vs universe: (a) R1 top-3 slot is anti-correlated with outcome when ma20_dist is outside +1..+5, and (b) confidence 70-85 band is an anti-signal. Applying both filters in shadow should raise India 5D WR toward or above universe baseline 32.25%.
cards.acceptance: Shadow 5D WR >= production 5D WR + 5pp AND shadow avg > production avg + 0.3% on n>=100 forward India predictions.

cards.title: India TIME_STOP_5D advisory · loss-control experiment
cards.hypothesis: Historical sweep shows TIME_STOP_5D expectancy -0.613% vs CURRENT -0.886% (gap +0.273%) AND catastrophic-loss rate 0.00% vs 0.20%. Advisory-only shadow should confirm this gap prospectively before any stop policy change.
cards.acceptance: Median advisory return over next 5D >= median current-policy return + 0.3% AND catastrophic-loss rate <= current on n>=100 advisory events.

cards.title: Technical filter · RSI + MA20 evidence-backed edges
cards.hypothesis: India OVERSOLD_lt30 RSI has 43.75% 5D WR (+18pp vs baseline). India above_+1_+5 ma20_dist has 37.17% WR (+11pp). India WEAK 30-45 RSI has 18.25% WR (-7pp) and below_-5_-1 ma20_dist has 17.97% WR (-8pp). Positive-filter tag on the good buckets and negative-filter tag on the bad ones should predict forward outcomes prospectively.
cards.acceptance: positive_filter_5D_WR - negative_filter_5D_WR >= 15pp on n>=100 total tagged observations.

cards.title: USA MID-cap tilt · cap-weighted selection experiment
cards.hypothesis: 30D corpus shows USA MID cap n=622 · 5D WR=46.60% · avg=+0.10% (only USA positive-avg cohort) beats LARGE n=459 · 5D WR=35.96% · avg=-0.84% by 10.64pp WR. Tilting selection toward MID and away from LARGE in shadow should confirm this prospectively.
cards.acceptance: shadow MID 5D WR - LARGE 5D WR >= 8pp on n>=100 forward USA predictions AND MID avg > LARGE avg by >= 0.5%.
